sentences.en: All families tell stories about themselves.
sentences.zh: 所有的家庭都会讲述关于自己的故事。

sentences.en: Those stories are passed down, and like an intergenerational game of telephone,
sentences.zh: 这些故事代代相传，就像一场跨代的传话游戏，

sentences.en: the details sometimes change from fact to fiction.
sentences.zh: 细节有时会从事实变成虚构。

sentences.en: I was always told that my grandpa sold Elvis his first guitar.
sentences.zh: 我一直被告知，我爷爷卖给了猫王他的第一把吉他。

sentences.en: My family did live in Memphis at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时我们家确实住在孟菲斯。

sentences.en: The family business was tuning pianos and selling instruments, so it is possible.
sentences.zh: 家族生意是调音钢琴和销售乐器，所以这并非不可能。

sentences.en: But every member of my family was an unabashed fabulist, so who knows?
sentences.zh: 但我的每个家人都是毫不掩饰的编故事高手，所以谁知道呢？

sentences.en: If you've ever wondered how much of your family lore is actually true,
sentences.zh: 如果你曾经好奇过你的家族传说有多少是真实的，

sentences.en: then I have a podcast for you.
sentences.zh: 那么我有一个播客要推荐给你。

sentences.en: And what's especially great about it is that one of the people who works on it
sentences.zh: 特别棒的一点是，其中一位工作人员

sentences.en: is from our 99PI family, Katie Mingle.
sentences.zh: 来自我们《99%隐形》的大家庭，凯蒂·明格尔。

sentences.en: Family Lore is a weekly narrative podcast that celebrates and investigates
sentences.zh: 《家族传说》是一档每周播出的叙事播客，旨在赞颂和探究

sentences.en: the stories families tell to themselves about themselves.
sentences.zh: 家庭成员之间讲述的关于他们自己的故事。

sentences.en: Here is an episode of Family Lore.

sentences.zh: 主持人是劳埃德·洛克里奇。

sentences.en: You might remember back in 1999, the United States Mint started producing specialty quarters.
sentences.zh: 你可能记得在1999年，美国铸币局开始发行特种25美分硬币。

sentences.en: On the back of each quarter, instead of an eagle spreading its wings and looking off to the side,
sentences.zh: 在每枚硬币的背面，不再是那只展开翅膀、侧头凝视的老鹰，

sentences.en: you'd see a unique design representing any given state.
sentences.zh: 你会看到代表各个州独特的设计。

sentences.en: For example, on the back of the Massachusetts quarter, you'd have a minute man.
sentences.zh: 例如，在马萨诸塞州的25美分硬币背面，你会看到一名民兵。

sentences.en: The Virginia quarter featured ships arriving at Jamestown in 1607.
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚州的硬币上则是1607年抵达詹姆斯敦的船只。

sentences.en: And on the back of the North Carolina quarter, you had a man lying prostrate on a primitive airplane with another man watching from below.
sentences.zh: 而在北卡罗来纳州的硬币背面，有一个人趴在一架原始飞机上，另一个人在下方注视着。

sentences.en: This, of course, was a depiction of the Wright brothers and their inaugural flight at the small beach town of Kitty Hawk.
sentences.zh: 这当然描绘的是莱特兄弟和他们在基蒂霍克小镇海滩上的首次飞行。

sentences.en: At the top of the coin is the inscription, First Flight.
sentences.zh: 硬币顶部刻着“首次飞行”的字样。

sentences.en: This is a story that virtually all Americans know.
sentences.zh: 这是一个几乎所有美国人都知道的故事。

sentences.en: The Wright brothers were the first to fly.
sentences.zh: 莱特兄弟是第一批飞行的人。

sentences.en: The Wright brothers invented the airplane.
Or at the very least, the Wright brothers were pioneers in the field of aviation.
sentences.zh: 或者至少，莱特兄弟是航空领域的先驱。

sentences.en: But there's another story you probably haven't heard that makes the origins of American aviation a little more complex.
sentences.zh: 但还有另一个你可能没听过的故事，它让美国航空的起源变得复杂了一些。

sentences.en: This story begins in Louisiana, a state not known for aviation.
sentences.zh: 这个故事始于路易斯安那州，一个并不以航空闻名的州。

sentences.en: With its bayous, swamps, labyrinthine coastline, and the nation's biggest river,
sentences.zh: 凭借其河口、沼泽、迷宫般的海岸线以及全国最大的河流，

sentences.en: the state is known for its boats.
Cajun pirogues, flat-bottom airboats, paddle steamers, the Higgins boat.
sentences.zh: 卡津平底船、平底气垫船、明轮船、希金斯登陆艇。

sentences.en: But the Louisiana man at the center of this episode's family lore was not interested in boats.
sentences.zh: 但本集家族传说核心的那位路易斯安那人对船只并不感兴趣。

sentences.en: He was not interested in navigating the water.
sentences.zh: 他对航行水域毫无兴趣。

sentences.en: Before the advent of airplanes, this man dreamed of navigating the sky.
sentences.zh: 在飞机出现之前，这个人梦想着航行天空。

sentences.en: His name was Charles Frederick Page.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫查尔斯·弗雷德里克·佩奇。
